text: A股三大指数全线翻红，元件、CPO、零售、氦气等板块涨幅居前；全市场超3000股上涨，天孚通信涨近8%，中际旭创、新易盛跟涨。
text_en: The three major A-share indices all turned positive, with components, CPO, retail, helium and other sectors leading gains; more than 3,000 stocks in the entire market rose, Tianfu Communication rose nearly 8%, and Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink followed with gains.
